svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Book one to one-and-a-half months before departure to obtain a better fare. → Find the bes
t available fare for the itinerary he has chosen.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Search many origin, destination, date and cabin combinations at the same time to find the
best option. → Find the best available fare for the itinerary he has chosen.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Compare the booking providers offered for a shortlisted itinerary and choose the one with
the lowest final price and best terms. → Find the best available fare for the itinerary he
has chosen.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Stay logged out and anonymous while searching for flights on the aggregator. → Keep his pe
rsonal data from being collected or shared by the flight search and booking sites.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Be alerted when fares on the specific routes he is watching drop, so that he can book at t
he lower price. → Find the best available fare for the itinerary he has chosen.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search by country or region instead of a single airport so that many airports are covered
in one query. → Search many origin, destination, date and cabin combinations at the same t
ime to find the best option.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Restrict search results to his preferred departure and arrival windows and to a maximum nu
mber of hours in the air. → Find a flight itinerary whose departure, arrival and connectio
n times fit his onward transport, hotel needs and the schedules of the people he is meetin
g.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Rule out itineraries with 40 to 60 hours of total travel even when they are the cheapest l
isted. → Find a flight itinerary whose departure, arrival and connection times fit his onw
ard transport, hotel needs and the schedules of the people he is meeting.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Allow at least 1.5 to 2 times the airport's minimum connection time at each connection. →
Find a flight itinerary whose departure, arrival and connection times fit his onward trans
port, hotel needs and the schedules of the people he is meeting.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Check whether the lounge at the connection airport is open at the connection time. → Take
routings with extra stops and lounge visits when he travels for pleasure and is not presse
d for time.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Have his card-based lounge entitlements kept up to date in one place and shown alongside t
he flight search. → Check whether the lounge at the connection airport is open at the conn
ection time.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Show whether a fare is above or below the median for markets he is unfamiliar with. → Find
the best available fare for the itinerary he has chosen.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Keep using the aggregator interface he already knows so that each search takes less time.
→ Cut the time spent researching flights while covering more combinations.
